description: This file implements an integration with PostHog for logging analytics events related to Large Language Models (LLMs). It defines a class `PostHogLogger` that manages event creation, batching, and sending (both synchronously and asynchronously), along with environment variable configuration, event payload construction, and proper cleanup on exit.

classes.name: PostHogLogger
classes.description: A logger class for sending LLM analytics events to PostHog, supporting batching, asynchronous and synchronous operations, with environment variable configuration and shutdown handling.

methods.name: __init__(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the PostHogLogger, checks env variables, sets up HTTP clients, handles errors, and registers cleanup hooks.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Synchronously logs a success event to PostHog, constructing payload and handling API response.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a success event, ensuring async setup and queuing for batch send.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failure event, similar to success event logging.

methods.name: _log_async_event(self, kwargs, response_obj=None, start_time=0.0, end_time=0.0)
methods.description: Adds an event to the internal queue for batch processing asynchronously.

methods.name: PostHogEventPayload create_posthog_event_payload(self, kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a structured event payload from request kwargs, following the PostHog and LLM analytics format.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _create_posthog_properties( self, standard_logging_object: StandardLoggingPayload, kwargs: Dict[str, Any], event_name: str, )
methods.description: Generates properties dictionary for an event, including model info, input/output, tokens, cost, latency, errors, trace, and custom metadata.

methods.name: _add_trace_properties(self, properties: Dict[str, Any], kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds trace-related identifiers (trace ID, span ID, parent ID) to event properties.

methods.name: _add_custom_metadata_properties(self, properties: Dict[str, Any], kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Incorporates additional custom metadata into event properties, filtering out internal fields.

methods.name: str _get_distinct_id( self, standard_logging_object: StandardLoggingPayload, kwargs: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Derives a distinct user identifier from metadata or fallback to UUID.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_credentials_for_request(self, kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Retrieves API credentials for the request, considering per-request overrides or defaults.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Sends queued events in batch asynchronously to PostHog.

methods.name: _ensure_async_setup(self)
methods.description: Initializes async components if not already set up.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _extract_metadata(self, kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extracts metadata dictionary from provided kwargs.

methods.name: str _safe_uuid(self)
methods.description: Generates a new UUID as string.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _create_posthog_payload(self, events: list, api_key: str)
methods.description: Builds the payload for batch sending to PostHog.

methods.name: Any _safe_get(self, obj: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)
methods.description: Safely retrieves a key from a dictionary-like object, with default fallback.

methods.name: _flush_on_exit(self)
methods.description: Flushes remaining queued events on program exit, both synchronously via the cache and API.
